title: PrintoutTranscriptionRecord
description: v0.1. Written by `python -m diocle_converter transcribe IMAGE --out SAMPLE_DIR` as SAMPLE_DIR/transcription.json: a vision model (Muse Wonder) reads an image of a COBOL listing and writes fixed-format COBOL; the model is never the judge. A compiler check (cobc -fsyntax-only -std=ibm) and, when an original is supplied, a byte-for-byte differential run of the transcription against the original (both compiled with GnuCOBOL, same generated inputs) decide whether the transcription is right.

status.description: verified-identical: compiled and every differential input matched byte for byte. differs: compiled but the differential found a mismatch (reported, never hidden). compiled-unchecked: compiled but not checked against the original (none supplied, running model code was not opted into, or the differential could not run), so correctness is NOT established. compile-failed: still not valid COBOL after the last attempt. no-transcription: the model returned no usable text. refused: the feature is off, the image or --out was rejected before any call, or the transcription failed the refusal scan (directives, tabs, free format, forbidden CALL, ASSIGN/COPY of anything but the original's names) (it is then never compiled, run or written).

reason.description: Why for refused / compile-failed / no-transcription / a differential that could not run

model.description: Vision model ID from VISION_MODEL_ID; null when the feature was off

source.description: Path of the written COBOL, relative to the output sample directory

attempts.description: One entry per model call. A failed compile sends the compiler errors back for at most one more attempt.

usage.description: Token use per call, priced at the model's list price (reasoning tokens bill as output); estimatedCostUsd is null for an unpriced model

oneOf.description: No original supplied, or the transcription did not compile

against.description: The original sample directory, as given

ran.description: false when the differential could not run (reason says why)

outputRecords.description: Output records the original wrote; verified-identical needs at least one (or non-empty stdout), otherwise ran is false

stdoutCompared.description: The original's stdout was non-empty, so it counts as compared (a DISPLAY-only original has outputRecords 0)

sandbox.description: Whether the transcription's executable ran under a macOS sandbox-exec profile

ranIn.description: Present when the transcription was built and run inside the sandbox container (the public printout button, `transcribe --sandbox`); absent for a local run

compile.description: cobc -fsyntax-only -std=ibm with the verifier's IBM flags
